objectives: To systematically evaluate the efficacy and safety of tRNS in various psychiatric disorders.
inclusion_criteria: This review focused on people who were diagnosed with a psychiatric illness and were being treated using tRNS. Since tRNS is a relatively newer neuromodulation technique, with fewer articles available on the subject matter, articles of quantitative, qualitative or mixed-method designs, case studies or series were all included. These articles focused on the safety, efficacy and clinical applicability of tRNS in the management of psychiatric disorders. Only peer reviewed articles published in the English language were selected.
